title: Graph Beta: wire graph commands and current-graph query
description: Graph Beta consumer of task-dd4ffa0c40834c59892f957fbf61fb23 and prerequisite for task-a9fd91c373c244c78df97945965a8038. Expose the existing graph.* runtime command kinds and graph.get query through the real daemon HTTP/MCP authentication and decision surfaces, delegating mutation/read work to the durable active-graph service. Measurement at HEAD a42ae2f1f9168d13b8b786404fc47b366cc8edd9: RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS already contains graph.approve, graph.prepare_supersession, graph.release_preparation, graph.request_expansion, and graph.supersede; RUNTIME_QUERY_KINDS contains graph.get; daemon-command-registry.ts wires none of them and mcp-dispatch-port.ts serves only work.get_context/events.read. Stage: GRAPH BETA. Not in scope: adding runtime kinds, Foundation attempt ingress, launch/workspace sourcing, or fan-out attempt dispatch.
definitionOfDone: The daemon command registry exposes every existing mutation kind in the bounded graph.* family with exact capability, family, payload allow-list, and stable refusal mapping; the real Authenticator runs before any graph payload field is read.

Each accepted graph mutation delegates to the landed @moe/core graph lifecycle and task-dd4ffa0c40834c59892f957fbf61fb23 durable service in one decision-bound transaction; the transport never reconstructs graph authority or trusts a caller-provided active projection.

The existing graph.get query is reachable through the production HTTP/MCP path and returns the durable current-project snapshot/revision/epoch from task-dd4ffa0c40834c59892f957fbf61fb23; absent or unverifiable state remains UNKNOWN with an exact code and layer.

Same-byte replay returns the original durable decision without duplicate graph events; conflicting bytes under one decision identity refuse with an exact replay-conflict code/layer and preserve the original event and decision counts.

Focused real SqliteEventStore + Authenticator tests assert authentication/capability/payload ordering, exact code/stage/layer for each refusal, nonzero generated-case counts, zero residue, one accepted mutation control, and one graph.get control; daemon typecheck and test gates execute with a nonzero test count.
taskRails: Hard-depend on task-dd4ffa0c40834c59892f957fbf61fb23 and consume its production projection; do not copy its fold into the registry or tests.
Use only existing graph command/query kinds from @moe/contracts; runtime vocabulary/schema expansion is forbidden in this slice.
Use the extracted daemon command registry and real Authenticator/CommandDecisionPort; do not reimplement transport, authentication, or decision identity.
Fail closed with stable reason codes/layers, use TDD, target <=250 lines per production source and split before 400, and preserve foreign shared-tree work.
reopenReason: Human instructed plan all filed Graph Beta prerequisites.
blockedReason: Fresh exploration shows this ticket is an integration umbrella, not a <=5-file implementation task, and its claimed production dependencies are absent. GraphRevisionEvent has no content bytes; the retracted task-77 plan wrongly equated structural graphIdentity with the broader design GraphRevisionContent hash. No daemon service produces GraphRevisionCreated/Submitted or persists graph.approve/supersede. graph.prepare_supersession/release_preparation have no durable paired SupersessionFundingReservation/PreparedPlanningFence lifecycle. graph.request_expansion's existing core reducer still lacks durable safe-release/current-hold authority (existing blocked e62/738/c417 chain). The registry is already 346 lines, and no approved graph capability/payload mapping exists. I SPIDR-split durable preparation (task-32c1ba45), atomic activation (task-eacea969), mutation ingress (task-931f99e8) and current query (task-c4b80778); efc2 becomes the final integration/hardening parent after those land. Submitting a direct plan now would invent authority, exceed the five-file quality bar, and create unreachable/mock-backed handlers.
